_comment: Editorial content for FASM. Every fact is attributable - see sourceNote. No image attached: no licence-cleared photograph of the company's own units is available. faisalspinning.com does not respond; the URL the company publishes in its own annual report is the Umer Group site, which is what website points to.
description: Faisal Spinning Mills Limited is a Umer Group company whose operations run across four units: a spinning unit at Nooriabad in Sindh, a weaving unit at Ferozewattwan in Sheikhupura, and finishing and home textile divisions on Warburton Road, Ferozewattwan. The company states that it is principally engaged in manufacturing and selling yarn, greige fabric, dyed fabric and home textile products, and reports those as its three reporting segments: spinning, weaving, and finishing and home textile. Its registered office is at Umer House in the Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi.
headOffice: Umer House, 23/1, Sector 23, S. M. Farooq Road, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi, Pakistan
